lead: A Lincoln County city about 20 miles southwest of Sioux Falls, founded in 1889.
living:
Lennox is in Lincoln County, about 20 miles southwest of Sioux Falls. It was founded in 1889, and the Census counted 2,423 people here in 2020.

It's a little farther out than Tea or Harrisburg, which is one reason buyers look here: you can often get a bigger lot or more house for the money while still working in Sioux Falls.
know: What to know before you buy in Lennox

• Commute: plan on about 25–30 minutes to central Sioux Falls, with I-29 a short drive east of town.
  • Mix of homes: older homes near downtown plus some newer subdivisions on the edges of town.
  • Few listings at a time: set up alerts so you see new Lennox homes the day they're listed.
  • Property taxes: Lennox is in Lincoln County, and the Lennox School District levy is part of the bill.
schools: Lennox is served by the Lennox School District. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.
faq:
What county is Lennox in?

Lennox is in Lincoln County. Property taxes are set by Lincoln County, the city and the local school district.

What school district serves Lennox?

Lennox is served by the Lennox School District. Always confirm the district for a specific address.

How far is Lennox from Sioux Falls?

Lennox is about 20 miles southwest of Sioux Falls. Plan on about 25–30 minutes to central Sioux Falls, with I-29 a short drive east of town.

Can I get down payment help to buy in Lennox?

Often, yes. South Dakota Housing programs, including Give Me Five, can be used for homes in Lennox if you and the home qualify. Income and price limits apply. See the down payment help options.
